title: Static and Archive
author: C. M. Voss
blurb: Lena Ishikawa, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the fleet's truce expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
